questions.question: Distinguish between minimum wage and floor wage / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Minimum wage - legally mandated wage –fixed by government authority –ensures basic
  • subsistence income– applies to specific scheduled employment–varies across sectors regions–
  • floor wage -nationally determined baseline –central government sets minimum benchmark –
  • states cannot fix wages below floor wage–ensures national wage protection– objective reducing
  • wage exploitation–promoting fair labour standards – difference in scope and authority –sector
  • specific versus national baseline – support for workers’ welfare –minimum income security
  • guarantee.
